entities.summary: Louis Okoye  is a Japanese professional baseball outfielder for the Sultanes de Monterrey of the Mexican League. He previously played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Tohoku Rakuten Golden Eagles and Yomiuri Giants.
